page.layout: Top: running head at upper right, page number at upper left. Below them two circular medallion portraits side by side, each with a vertical inscription (left "IEPTB", right "ABZAN"). Below the medallions one column of running text in two paragraphs. A small woodcut ornament at the foot, without text.

main_text.l: IEPTB[?]
ABZAN
IEPHTE, filius Galaad ex meretrice, iudicauit populum
Israël anno mundi 2787. ante Christum natum 1175. Hic pu-
gnauit contra Ammonitas, quos tradidit dominus in manus
eius. vouerat autem prius, satis tamen imprudenter, se in holo-
caustum oblaturū domino eum qui primus de domo sua egre-
diens, sibi occurreret victori: accidítque vt filia sua vnigenita
cum tympanis & choris ei reuertenti occurreret, qua visa sci-
dit ipse sua sibi vestimēta, præ dolore: immolauit tamen filiam
post duos menses, quos illa impetrarat ad lugendam virginita-
tem. Vide lib.Iudi.cap.11.& 12.fex annis iudicauit Iephte Israë-
lem. Ioseph.lib.Antiq.5.cap.12.
ABESAN, de Beth-lehem, mortuo Iephte iudicauit Is-
raël septem annis. Hic habuit triginta filios & totidem filias,
quas omnes maritis tradidit, simul filiis omnibus vxores dedit:
foras misit filias, filiorum autem vxores domum suam intro-
duxit. Iudi.12. Ioseph.lib.5.cap.12. Rabbi Salomon & Chaldæus
paraphrastes hūc Abesan Boos esse dicunt. Post Abesan, Aelon
de tribu Zabulon, iudicauit populum annos decem: post quem
etiam Abdon de tribu Ephraim, iudicauit Israëlē annos octo.
Iudicum cap.12. post hunc Samson iudicauit, cuius meminero
postea.

page.notes: Medallion inscriptions are set vertically along the rims; the first letter of the left one is read as B, possibly E, so marked [?]. Woodcut portraits and the ornament carry no further text. Greek and Hebrew: none printed. Marked "Vide lib.Iudi.cap.11.& 12." kept as printed (the reference "fex" is printed as such, probably "sex").
